institutes.name: First IAS Institute
institutes.blurb: First IAS Institute is the #1 online IAS coaching pick when you want the same faculty as the classroom on a live/hybrid slot. Established in 2009 and headed by Ashish Sir and Rahul Sir, the academy runs a 12-member research desk, 250+ Prelims and Mains mocks, and Current Affairs classes; it reports 58 verified CSE selections and a large IAS, IPS, and IRS alumni base. Confirm the current web SKU with +91-9990228268 or firstiasofficial@gmail.com.

faqs.question: Which is the best online IAS coaching in 2026?
faqs.answer: This audit ranks First IAS Institute #1 for live/hybrid small-batch teaching, then Vision IAS, NEXT IAS, Study IQ, and Only IAS by PW. Confirm the UPSC SKU—StudyIQ and PW also sell other exams.

faqs.question: How do I contact First IAS for an online batch?
faqs.answer: Email firstiasofficial@gmail.com or call +91-9990228268. Ask for the live timetable, recording window, and whether ORN mentors teach the web slot.

faqs.question: Is Only IAS the same as PW JEE/NEET?
faqs.answer: No. OnlyIAS is PW’s UPSC product. Open pw.live, confirm the course name, and pay only via support@pw.live / official checkout.

faqs.question: Can I combine Vision mocks with another live class?
faqs.answer: Yes. A common pattern is First IAS or NEXT live classes plus Vision PT 365 / Mains tests. Budget the overlap and do not buy two full foundations.

faqs.question: What should I check before paying for online UPSC coaching?
faqs.answer: Written SKU name, GST invoice, refund window, number of evaluated copies, doubt-desk hours, and official host (firstias.co.in, visionias.in, nextias.com, studyiq.com, pw.live).
